items.title: Cripple a Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and use V.A.T.S. to target the leg.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Cranberry Bog Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Quarry X3, equip a Fishing Rod, and complete the reeling mini-game.

items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Collect from a Brewing Vat at your C.A.M.P. or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; yields vary by fish size.

items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Complete kills, events, and quests; West Tek or raids are fastest.

items.title: Kill a Yao Guai
items.detail: Fast travel to High Knob Lookout and use V.A.T.S. to target the head.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team, start the Disturbed Grave quest, equip a shovel and kill enemies anywhere.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Build and scrap basic wood or concrete floors in build menu to minimize resource cost.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find and clear the gray cloudy area on map; fight through enemies to defeat the boss.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable spawns.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume items like BlamCo Mac and Cheese or collect from Weenie Wagon, Popcorn Machine, or Cookie Jar.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond and use V.A.T.S. to target the eyes as weak spot.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Locate an active Infestation and defeat Phantoms inside the marked hotspot.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp, then wait for Phantom to spawn in Vertibot area.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community contest to build C.A.M.P.s inspired by classic slasher movies with prizes.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantoms and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation chance during Daily Ops with new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt spooky variants of Scorched enemies for new cosmetic rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn experience points at twice the normal rate across all activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this special weekend event.
